objective: Integrate tokenless four-step earned-return memory with exact FKP24 public choose(state,history), observe(public_record) policy contract without opening source-private causal environments.
source_boundary: Deterministic source-free mocks ONLY. CausalGym constructs/resets/do and source first-use ZERO. Legal seed labels in mocks are not actual MDP use.
hypothesis: A source-blind policy can use public-only action-observation interface with delayed rewards, conservative exploration, retained completed outcomes, failure-closed uncertain actions/reset.
requirements: accept only exact six-field PublicConsequence and binary state/action; forbid hidden info
choose must not consume future reward or execute source calls
observe must match pending chosen action/state and public history
duplicate choose or unexpected observe rejects without mutation
terminal or truncation closes episode; next episode can retain consequences without leakage
unclosed budget-exhausted episode refuses ambiguous new reset, no forged final reward or replay
cold after witnessed observation restores exact model; cold during unobserved action refuses
candidate online sums match independently computed conventional batch on same records
full FKP24 public_mechanical_episode mock-only integration against inherited source when available; no external CausalGym imports
fixed negative tests and deterministic receipts frozen before scored outcomes
limits: Source-safe integration engineering only. No scientific learning, native acceptance, resource advantage or real CausalGym first-use; dual-OS/G29 UNVERIFIED.
authority: Research-only branch. No main/owner PR/workflow/runner/controller/scheduler/paid API/merge/deployment/original source first-use.
